sprint.name: Repository Intelligence Pipeline
sprint.objective: Implement the first executable Repository Intelligence pipeline: scripted facts -> context -> current.md generation, replacing manual skill-invoked regeneration.

task.summary: Build .engineering/scripts/{generate.py,generate_facts.py,generate_context.py,generate_current_md.py}; split engineering state into generated facts.json and this hand-maintained decisions.json; regenerate context.json and current.md via script.

decisions_awaiting_approval.topic: Statement Parser real extraction approach (PDF parsing method)

architecture_decisions.decision: context.json is generated entirely from facts.json + decisions.json; it is no longer hand-edited.
repository.json and executives.json remain separate, hand-maintained files for now; not merged into facts.json/decisions.json this sprint.

decisions.json is the only human-maintained engineering-state file (sprint, task, outstanding decisions, next action, architecture decisions). All other .engineering/*.json content is either generated (facts.json, context.json) or a to-be-reviewed legacy hand-maintained file (repository.json, executives.json, workflows.json, commands.json, metrics.json).

next_action: Add live service-status probing (stdlib socket/HTTP, short timeout) to generate_facts.py so service up/down state becomes a generated fact instead of the hand-typed, easily-stale status strings currently in repository.json.
